notes.title: New Gloomy Juncture Demo – Major Update (Shift to Run) & Discord Server Live!
notes.notes:
Hello, dear inhabitants of this Gloomy Juncture,

I’m excited to announce that Demo v0.7.2 of Gloomy Juncture is now live! Thanks to the incredible feedback I've received from the Tiny Teams 2024 community (a huge shoutout to all the new players) and the insights from the Indie Cup Europe '24 jurors, I’ve been working hard to apply a new layer of polish, improvements, and quality-of-life updates to the game and demo.

This update brings the Gloomy Juncture demo closer to it's final experience, and It would mean a lot to me if you gave it a try. Whether you’re discovering it for the first time or returning for another playthrough, I’m confident you'll notice a more refined and immersive experience.

Gloomy Juncture v0.7.2
The update includes the following changes:

 Added new Splash Screen & Intro Credits.
 Revamped the game's introduction to clarify the setting, story and player objectives.
 Introduced new voice narrations as subtle hints, triggered by interactions and events.
 Added new voice narrations to provide deeper insight into the game world.
 New remarks from the cretin to enhance the world and player understanding of the setting.
 New voice narrations for the Wrong Usage of items. More intuitive voiceovers that enhance gameplay feedback.
 Refined the puzzle design and clarity with updated assets, improved interfaces and enhanced visual/audio cues. Providing clearer feedback on player actions and progress. Some specific puzzle enhancements include:
    • Power Panel: Updated interface with intuitive animations and a progress indicator.
    • Dragon Dungeon: Implemented a new AI system for a more strategic gameplay.
    • Fortune Teller: Enhanced the pipe-following by adding shadow projections on pipes, improving depth perception and reducing frustration.
 New RUN feature. Press Shift to move faster (key binding can be changed). 
 Head Bobbing during run can be toggled on/off in Settings.
 Updated journal entries and inventory item descriptions for a better fit within the game's atmosphere.
 Added new assets and models as subtle enhancements, designed to enrich the narrative atmosphere without directly affecting gameplay.
 Fixed an issue where journal entries were not scaling correctly with certain screen resolutions.
 Fixed an issue where the player character would occasionally move for a few frames before stopping when a cutscene was triggered.
 Improved 3D audio distance attenuation on certain objects. 
 Improved shadows to better align with maximum gamma and brightness settings, ensuring visual consistency across different screens and configurations.
 Improved interactions with certain game objects, reducing frustration caused by obstructions and awkward angles.
 Enhanced some Japanese translations for improved clarity and accuracy.

Discord Server
I've also (finally) created a Discord server. Please feel free to join if you want to hangout, provide feedback on this new update, or even help me with playtesting.
Note: I'll be providing beta keys as soon as new builds are ready to test. 

Discord Invite Link: https://discord.gg/Xh5qY7W7fX


Hope to see your feedback on Discord.

Thank you,
Filipe

notes.title: Update: New Gameplay Trailer, Steam Next Fest Highlights
notes.notes:
Hello, dear inhabitants of this Gloomy Juncture,

UPDATED GAMEPLAY TRAILER
I've updated the gameplay trailer to better reflect the new color grading technique not present in the previous release. Although still a work in progress, I believe this update better captures the unique features and gameplay of Gloomy Juncture.

[previewyoutube=L6-0W3FDwMk;full][/previewyoutube]
Steam Next Fest February 2024
I want to extend a warm welcome to all the new inhabitants. During SNF, Gloomy Juncture had a remarkable increase of 150% in wishlists, 7750 demo downloads, and a total of (at least) 1149 hours watched on Twitch. Thank you so much for your support.

I also want to express my gratitude to everyone who took the time to send messages of love and feedback. It's truly heartwarming to see a weird game, which started as nothing more than a passion project and escapism hobby of mine, resonating with so many weird peeps.

Thank you, dear inhabitants of this Gloomy Juncture.
Filipe

notes.title: Exploring the Artistic Journey of Gloomy Juncture | Dev Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, dear inhabitants of this Gloomy Juncture.

For the past 2.5 years, I have poured my heart and soul into this project.
So why is it taking so long? Gloomy Juncture is a first person 3D game where every single asset is meticulously and exclusively hand-drawn by me. Discover more about this process in the video below.

[previewyoutube=0JqQ3BCk_k0;full][/previewyoutube]
DEV STATUS

I'm actively working to expand the game's content, ensuring that it lives up to the high standards I've set for it. However, there are still two entire levels that need my attention. Crafting each element by hand is a time-consuming process, but it's the only way to achieve the artistic vision I have in mind.

UPDATE ON RELEASE DATE

I hope to release Gloomy Juncture in early 2024, but I refrain from compromising on an exact date at this time. I won't compromise on quality or rush the process. 

Rest assured, when Gloomy Juncture is ready and I am genuinely happy with the final product, it will be launched for all to enjoy. 

I'm immensely grateful for your patience and support throughout this journey. Please stay tuned for further updates as we draw closer to the release date.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/71119bd0ea4f42ae9d80efc9e4d064f973f4f064.png
Thank you,
Filipe
